lan.description: Wi-Fi / LAN. Native panel resolution (pixel-perfect, zero resampling) at 250% Retina scale. Logical desktop ~1101x826. Best quality; needs a fast link.

usb.description: USB (Apple Mobile Device Ethernet is ~100 Mbps). Exact half of native, so the panel upscales by a clean 2x (still no blur), at 125% scale. Identical ~1101x826 logical desktop as 'lan', so windows keep their places; one quarter of the pixels to push.

_notes.why_these_numbers: Only native (2752x2064) and its exact integer fractions map onto the panel without resampling blur. 1376x1032 is exactly half on both axes. No standard 4:3 preset (1024x768, 1280x960, 1600x1200, 2048x1536) divides 2752x2064 evenly.
_notes.scale_steps: Valid DPI scale values are the Windows steps only: 100,125,150,175,200,225,250,300,350,400,450,500.
_notes.customize: Edit width/height/scale for your own tablet, or add new profiles. Pass one with -Profile <name>; with no -Profile, 'defaultProfile' above is applied. 'matchString' is honored on every run.
